what: Plan says decompose annotate mirrors file-design-oos but does not gate .decompose-issues-filed on all pieces succeeding
scenario_or_breakage: file-design-oos uses $DESIGN_TMPDIR/oos-issues-created.md and OOS_FILE_MAP lines, then moves the sentinel before checking ISSUES_FAILED; copying that shape with PARTITION_FILE_MAP would allow ISSUES_CREATED < ISSUES_TOTAL to write .decompose-issues-filed, so failure mode 7 would skip re-filing and close the original with unfiled pieces hidden
suggested_fix: Add an explicit annotate invariant: write .decompose-issues-filed atomically only when ISSUES_FAILED=0 and every partition piece has a URL or duplicate URL; on partial success write only partition-filed.md/partial progress and return non-zero

what: Failure mode 6 suppresses the filing sentinel without defining mechanical partial-progress recovery
scenario_or_breakage: If ISSUES_FAILED > 0 after some issues were created, both .decompose-issues-filed and .decompose-original-closed can be absent; a rerun regenerates the full batch and can duplicate already-filed pieces unless /larch:issue dedup happens to catch them
suggested_fix: Define a partial-progress contract: persist PARTITION_FILE_MAP rows for successes in a non-terminal progress file, have prepare/annotate trim already-filed pieces and rewrite dependency indices for remaining pieces, and reserve .decompose-issues-filed for complete success only
